text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error-rate + latency spike for model family orchid7b in us-west-2. 5xxs +12% and RPM +220% vs baseline. Automated softcap applied but errors persist. Paging eng-oncall.

Maya: ACK — looking now.

Rahul: Seeing the spike is dominated by a single API key (acct: ACCT-985) with lots of long-context streaming. 502/504s and queue time up.

Maya: Ok. Proposal: temporary per-family quota change — reduce RPM by ~50% and TPM by ~40% for orchid7b in us-west-2 to shed load, and enable fallback to orchid7b-v1-quantized for hosted tier.

Kevin: I can apply a surgical trim. Applying RPM->1200 TPM->2000 scoped to us-west-2 and hosted tier now.

Kevin: Command I used:
```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/admin/quotas 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"model_family":"orchid7b","region":"us-west-2","rpm":1200,"tpm":2000,"scope":"hosted","note":"emergency surge 1749994321"}'
```

deploy-bot: Quota update recorded. orchid7b RPM=1200 TPM=2000 (us-west-2, hosted). Change effective immediately.

Maya: Also recommend disabling function-calling for orchid7b in hosted tier — those calls are driving memory pressure and KV-cache churn.

Rahul: Turning off function_calling for orchid7b (hosted) now. Patch applied to policy config.

Rahul: Early metrics: 5xx rate down ~30% since quota trim + funcalls off; p50 latency decreased ~18%.

Lindsey: CS/Status note: small number of enterprise customers in EU are experiencing higher tail latency (not full failures). We're opening tickets and posting to status page.

cs-ops: Ticket #INC-12345 created and assigned to CS. Notifying affected customers with ETA: monitoring now.

Maya: Monitoring window 10m. If RPM stays >1500 sustained or 5xxs >5%, escalate to SRE and consider regional drainage or broader family softcap. Otherwise we'll plan stepwise rollback after 30m.

Kevin: Will watch autoscale and capacity. Handing off to night oncall, @Nora in 30m. Key notes: orchid7b trimmed, function_calling disabled, fallback to v1-quantized enabled for hosted.

Nora: ACK. I'll take over monitoring and will escalate if error budget trends up. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Observability: dashboard -> https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/orchid7b?region=us-west-2; logs -> https://logs.redwood/query?q=orchid7b%205xx

Maya: Thanks team. Leaving thread open for post-incident notes and follow-up on quota rollback plan.

incident-bot: ALERT UPDATE: metrics returning toward baseline after interventions. Closing pager, keeping thread open for follow-up and postmortem actions.
